senses.gloss:
द्रौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sown with a Dronā of grain, (fields, &c.)
f. (की) A vessel holding a Dronā by measure.
 E. द्रोण the
measure, ठञ् or ठन् affix; also with अण् and ङीष् affixes in the last
sense. द्रौणी ।

द्रौपदी f. (-दी) A proper name. DRAUPADĪ, the daughter of DRUPADA,
king of Panchāla, and the common wife of the five Pāndava
princes.
 E. द्रपद the father of this lady, and अण् and ङीप् affixes.
